intro: Ten stories from the last day, rewritten in plain British English. Tap any word you don't know.

items.title: Iran attacks US bases in Bahrain
items.text: Iran launched two waves of drone and missile attacks on four US bases in Bahrain on Saturday night, according to Iranian media. Bahrain said its air defences stopped several of the attacks and told residents to shelter. At least three oil tankers were also attacked in or near the Strait of Hormuz, and no casualties were reported. More than 14 Iranian tankers were said to be ready to break the US blockade. President Trump told Fox News that he wanted a "permanent deal" with Iran.

gloss.intercept: to stop something before it reaches its target
gloss.shelter: to go somewhere safe to avoid danger
gloss.tanker: a large ship that carries oil
gloss.blockade: the use of ships to stop people or goods entering or leaving a place
gloss.break the blockade: to get past a blockade by force
gloss.permanent: lasting for a very long time or for ever

items.title: Macron warns of Russian aggression
items.text: French President Emmanuel Macron warned on Friday of a "new level" of Russian aggression after a series of incidents in Europe. Polish authorities said two Russian missiles and a jet-powered drone had crashed in Poland during allied exercises. Estonia said it will suspend all road border crossings with Russia from 1 December after what it called a sabotage attempt. Moldova closed its airspace after a drone was detected heading for its capital. Ukraine's president said Russia had fired more than 400 drones and over 110 missiles overnight.

gloss.aggression: hostile or violent behaviour towards another country
gloss.sabotage: deliberate damage to stop something working
gloss.suspend: to stop something for a period of time
gloss.airspace: the sky above a country that it controls

items.title: UK and EU agree post-Brexit reset deal
items.text: Prime Minister Andy Burnham travelled to Brussels on Friday for a summit between the United Kingdom and the European Union. He was welcomed by European Council President Antonio Costa. Euronews reported that the two sides struck a post-Brexit reset deal at the meeting. A reset is an attempt to improve relations after years of tension since Britain left the EU. Commentators said the next big question is how far Britain wants to move closer to Europe.

gloss.summit: a formal meeting between the leaders of countries
gloss.reset: a fresh start, especially in a relationship
gloss.tension: a feeling of worry or conflict between people or countries
gloss.commentator: a person who gives opinions on the news

items.title: Leeds win 4-1 at Chelsea
items.text: Leeds United won 4-1 at Stamford Bridge on Saturday, their first win at Chelsea since 1999. Noah Okafor scored twice for Leeds, and Dominic Calvert-Lewin added a penalty after a long VAR check. Substitute Brenden Aaronson scored in stoppage time. Chelsea midfielder Moises Caicedo was injured and had to come off. Elsewhere, Newcastle drew 2-2 with Arsenal, Manchester City drew 1-1 with Fulham and Tottenham beat Ipswich 2-0.

gloss.penalty: a free shot at goal given after a foul in the box
gloss.VAR: video technology used to check referee decisions
gloss.stoppage time: extra minutes added at the end of a match
gloss.substitute: a player who comes on to replace another
gloss.come off: to leave the pitch during a match
gloss.draw: to finish a match with the same score

items.title: Zverev and Alcaraz reach ATP semis
items.text: The semi-final line-up is set at the ATP Finals in Turin. Top seed Alexander Zverev plays Daniil Medvedev, and Carlos Alcaraz plays Ben Shelton. On Friday, Alcaraz beat Flavio Cobolli 6-1 6-4, and Medvedev beat Frances Tiafoe 6-3 6-4. Zverev had already qualified for the last four earlier in the week after beating Shelton in straight sets. The tournament runs until Sunday, when the final takes place at the Inalpi Arena.

gloss.semi-final: one of the two matches that decide who plays in the final
gloss.line-up: the list of people or teams taking part
gloss.seed: a player ranked and placed in the draw according to their level
gloss.qualify: to earn a place in a competition
gloss.run: to continue for a period of time

items.title: Hackers leak data of 16,000 bank customers
items.text: Hackers have published stolen data linked to about 16,000 customers of Visa, Mastercard and JPMorgan, Euronews reported on Friday. A data leak happens when criminals take private information and then make it public. Details of how the data was stolen have not been confirmed in the report. After leaks like this, banks and card companies often advise customers to check their statements and change their passwords.

gloss.hacker: a person who gets into computer systems without permission
gloss.confirm: to say that something is definitely true
gloss.statement: a document showing money paid into or out of a bank account
gloss.password: a secret word used to log in to an account

items.title: Keto diet cuts liver fat by 67%
items.text: A US trial has found that a ketogenic diet reduced liver fat more than two other diets. The study, published in Cell Metabolism, followed 42 adults with obesity, prediabetes and fatty liver disease. All groups lost about 10% of their body weight over four to five months. Average liver fat fell by 67% on the keto diet, compared with 45% on Mediterranean and low-fat diets. About half of the keto group no longer met the criteria for prediabetes.

gloss.trial: a scientific test of a treatment or method
gloss.ketogenic diet: an eating plan very low in carbohydrates and high in fat
gloss.fatty liver disease: a condition in which too much fat builds up in the liver
gloss.prediabetes: a condition where blood sugar is higher than normal but not yet diabetes
gloss.criteria: the standards used to decide something
gloss.compared with: when you look at two things to see how they differ

items.title: Kate speaks about cancer in documentary
items.text: Catherine, Princess of Wales, speaks openly about how cancer changed her body and mind in a new documentary, Euronews reported on Saturday. The Princess announced in March 2024 that she was receiving chemotherapy. She said in January 2025 that she was in remission. Her willingness to talk about the illness has drawn wide attention in Britain.

gloss.documentary: a film or TV programme about real events or people
gloss.chemotherapy: medical treatment for cancer using strong drugs
gloss.remission: a period when an illness gets better or cannot be detected
gloss.openly: in an honest way, without hiding anything

items.title: Bending Spoons buys Mailchimp for $3.68bn
items.text: The Italian company Bending Spoons has agreed to buy the email marketing firm Mailchimp from Intuit for $3.68 billion in cash. Intuit bought Mailchimp for about $12 billion five years ago. Reports say Intuit will reinvest $368 million in the deal. The sale shows how much the business has fallen in value since then.

gloss.acquire: to get a company by buying it
gloss.reinvest: to put money back into a business
gloss.in cash: paid in money rather than shares
gloss.fall in value: to be worth less than before

items.title: GTA VI sets $3.79bn first-day record
items.text: Take-Two says Grand Theft Auto VI earned $3.79 billion in its first day, a record for entertainment, based on company estimates. The game had already sold 32.5 million copies before release. It has a Metacritic score of 99, according to the company. Rockstar Games founder Sam Houser said the team was "incredibly humbled" by the response. The game is set in Vice City and the state of Leonida, and it is out on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

gloss.estimate: a rough calculation of an amount
gloss.record: the best or highest result ever achieved
gloss.copies: individual units of a game sold
gloss.launch: the time when a product first goes on sale
gloss.set in: taking place in a particular place or time
